title: Chapter 144 Enemies In The True Self Realm
content:
Chapter 144 Enemies In The True Self Realm

At this moment, A Wei achieved the God of Swords, and the strength of the Desolate City has undoubtedly reached the peak of the known star field.

If it weren't for the fact that Yan Lingyun was in charge of the Divine Dynasty.

Otherwise, even the Divine Dynasty might not be the opponent of the Desolate City now.

However, just when everyone was happy, a dull explosion suddenly sounded from a distance.

Suddenly, countless strong men present paused.

An extremely ominous premonition arose from the bottom of their hearts.

The direction from which the sound came was exactly the border of an unknown star field.

Long ago, they had already known some things.

Seventy percent of the power of the Divine Dynasty was used to guard the border, and the border of the unknown star field was particularly important.

There is no doubt that the Divine Dynasty Queen Yan Lingyun has always been on guard against the unknown star field.

Unknown strong men.

Sure enough, several figures soon rushed here.

There were strong men from the Divine Dynasty and spies sent out by the Desolate City.

"No, it's bad, the unknown border has been broken!"

When these words came out, everyone in the audience was shocked.

Some people showed fear, some frowned, and some were extremely excited.

"Do you know who did it?"

At this time, someone asked.

The messenger shook his head, obviously not knowing much.

But another powerful man from the Divine Dynasty said in a deep voice: "Everyone, His Majesty has ordered everyone to go to the unknown border immediately."

Hearing this, everyone looked at each other and nodded.

Yunqi directly took out his 30-meter long sword, with a sky-high fighting spirit, which shocked everyone present. He smiled evilly and said: "I can't wait any longer."

Since Yunqi got the opportunity in the God of War Star Domain and became the God of War, Yunqi has become more and more hungry for war.

I knew that there would be enemies in the unknown star domain, but I didn't expect that I would wait so long for this day.

Buzz——

Huang Shou waved the magic sword in his hand, and suddenly a terrifying sword intent rushed directly to his face.

Ten thousand years later, Huang Shou's sword intent has become more mature than before.

"We in Huangcheng are never afraid of anything."

"Brother Huang said it well!"

Gu Chen and others stepped forward to respond.

As high-level officials in Huangcheng, almost none of them are now less powerful than the super-god realm.

The people of the Divine Dynasty looked at the strength of the people in Huangcheng and couldn't help but have complicated expressions.

Huangcheng is really so terrifying.

They couldn't help but yearn for the Lord of Huangcheng, whom they had never met.

What kind of person can build such a huge city and gather such terrifying subordinates?

Without time to think about it, everyone began to rush towards the unknown border without stopping.

The army filled with terrifying killing aura, led by Yunqi, stepped on the starry sky, marching forward, with great momentum.

This is the invincible army of the deserted city, the Lu family army.

So far, this army has never suffered a defeat.

Wherever it passes, there is no third possibility except surrender or being trampled.

At the same time, in the Divine Dynasty.

Lu Xue trotted all the way to Yan Lingyun's bedroom.

"Your Highness, His Majesty is in seclusion."

At this time, a phantom appeared in front of Lu Xue and reminded her.

Hearing this, Lu Xue frowned slightly, sighed slightly, and then said: "I know."

After saying that, Lu Xue turned and left.

"My lady, you'd better not go. Even if you tell the mistress, the mistress will definitely not agree."

At the cuff, Ao Qing poked his head out and said helplessly.

Hearing this, Lu Xue curled her lips, "What are you talking about? I'm no worse than you."

She beat Ao Qing up last time, and she still remembered it.

Hearing Lu Xue's words, Ao Qing's mouth twitched slightly.

My dear, that's because I didn't fight back. If I really fought back, you would probably be beaten to tears and look for your mother.

By then, I might be skinned and stewed into dragon soup.

Unfortunately, Ao Qing could only say these words in his heart, and continued to persuade: "My dear, the battlefield is really dangerous."

"And with Gu Chen and the others, I believe it can be solved."

Although I don't know how strong the opponent is, it can make the master's wife Yan Lingyun conquer all known star fields and concentrate her strength to fight. I think it won't be bad.

Ao Qing's words are not unreasonable.

Lu Xue pondered for a moment, and the impulse to participate in the exhibition was much smaller.

But she always felt that something was not good.

Is she practicing so much just to hide behind when there is danger?

At this moment, Lu Xue really wanted to ask her father in person.

Is it really like this?

However, Lu Daosheng was not by her side.

Alas.

Lu Xue sighed, and left here slowly with a bit of loss.

Deep in the palace.

Yan Lingyun, who was sitting cross-legged on the ground, slowly opened her eyes, with a touch of complexity and a hint of relief in her eyes.

"My daughter has grown up."

However, as Ao Qing said, she really couldn't bear to watch Lu Xue participate in this war.

Even though she knew that flowers in a greenhouse were not a good thing.

Although she was 90% sure, what if.

What if there were uncontrollable factors that she didn't even expect.

This was her only daughter. Lu Daosheng was relieved to let Lu Xue stay with him, and he had to be responsible for Lu Xue.

Thinking of this, Yan Lingyun took a deep breath and looked towards the unknown border with a cold expression.

Suddenly, the terrifying gaze penetrated the endless void and reached there directly.

An illusory figure stood there, with a mysterious and powerful aura.

Sensing Yan Lingyun's gaze, the shadow immediately looked over along the trajectory.

Seeing Yan Lingyun, a trace of horror appeared in the eyes of the shadow.

"It's you! You, you are still alive!"

Seeing Yan Lingyun, the shadow seemed to have seen a ghost, and his eyes were full of disbelief.

After the doubt, followed by a monstrous murderous intent.

"Damn woman, this time, I must make your soul fly away and die without a single chance of survival!!\

,"The roar sounded from the starry sky.

Mixed with a terrifying aura, it stretched across the endless starry sky.

Suddenly, the entire space began to collapse.

And the aura of the shadow was no longer concealed, and it was actually above the super god realm.

True self realm!

(Lin Shen Realm, Shenming Realm, Shenwang Realm, Shenjun Realm, Shenzhu Realm, Shendi Realm, Chaoshen Realm, Possessed God Realm, True Self Realm, Mortal Realm, Transmundane Realm)

Feeling the breath of the True Self Realm, countless strong men who were already approaching the unknown border were suddenly horrified.

What they were about to face was actually this kind of existence.

"The True Self Realm is a bit difficult to deal with."

Someone frowned.

"Haha, what are you afraid of? Don't forget, there is still His Majesty."

The strong man of the Divine Dynasty snorted, obviously not taking the mysterious strong man of the True Self Realm seriously.

Everyone nodded in understanding after hearing this.

It makes sense, what are you afraid of.
